name: assign_community_service
description: Guard identifies fisher with lowest catch for community service

prompt.template:
You are acting as the lake guard. Please identify the fisher(s) with the lowest weekly catch to assign community service.

If there is a tie, resolve it by random draw.

Respond with ONLY this JSON object, nothing else:
{{"assigned_fisher": {{"agent_id": "<agent_id>", "reasoning": "<one or two sentences, in character>"}}}}
